label: Dubstep / Drumstep (Half-Time Drum and Bass)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 172-174 BPM, felt half-time 86-87 BPM
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: Dark and propulsive: the intro brings atmospheric pads and a tense, ticking beat, a snare-roll build leads into a half-time drop with a growling bass, a breakdown gives a short melodic moment, and a final drop flips between half-time and…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Chopped, pitched vocal hits are played like a synth, forming short melodic stabs between the bass phrases.
cards.palette: A growling, detuned mid-bass with a fast wobble plays a short minor riff in the drops over a heavy mono sub, alternating between long notes and quick stabs.
cards.tempo_line: written 174 BPM, felt half-time as 87 BPM

cards.mood: Emotional and driving: the verses sit on a sparse half-time beat with a soft pad, the pre-chorus accelerates with snare rolls, and the hook lands as a huge half-time drop. After a short melodic bridge a final drop alternates half-time and…
cards.vocal: Singer A (Female). The vocalist possesses a bright, clear, powerful pop timbre with a strong, controlled belt.
cards.palette: A wide, detuned supersaw-style pad and a growling mid-bass carry the hook's drop over a heavy sub, with the bass playing the melody as a simplified echo of the vocal.
cards.tempo_line: written 172 BPM, felt half-time as 86 BPM
